{{Quote|I went to the doctor at the spaceport. She said it was a reversible condition and gave me medicines.|Kaminne Sihn about the doctor|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
This '''[[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]]''' was based on the [[Dathomir Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="Backlash" />

Sometime before [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], when the annual conclave between the [[Raining Leaves Clan]]&mdash;a clan of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]]&mdash;and [[Broken Columns Clan]]&mdash;a clan made up of [[Gender/Legends|men]]&mdash;was to be held, [[Kaminne Sihn]], the leader of the Raining Leaves Clan, went to the Dathomir Spaceport's doctor to seek help regarding her condition. Sihn, like most of her female family members, had a problem bearing a child. The doctor then gave Sihn some medicine to reverse the condition.<ref name="Backlash" />
